# A SkyPilot task YAML runs through the existing lowerer with the
# configuration's infra binding. The workdir is frozen at run: a replay
# uploads nothing new and runs the frozen snapshot, not the directory as
# it is later.

skygo-ec2 start -config $CONFIG -state $STATE -credentials $CREDS -interval 0
code 0

lose SubmitWorkspaceJob 1
! job run -job $WORK/job -yaml $WORK/task.yaml -workdir $WORK/src -outputs out -task-timeout 60s -poll 100ms
code 1
stdout '"submit": "sent"'

cp $WORK/changed.txt $WORK/src/input.txt
job resume -job $WORK/job -poll 100ms
code 0
stdout '"state": "SUCCEEDED"'
accepted BeginArtifactUpload 1
accepted WriteArtifactChunk 1
output $WORK/job out/result.txt frozen
output $WORK/job out/prepared.txt prepared

# The frozen snapshot is checked before it is uploaded: a job whose
# session never opened, and whose snapshot then changed, sends no Begin.
openfail
! job run -job $WORK/tampered -yaml $WORK/task.yaml -workdir $WORK/src -outputs out -task-timeout 60s
code 1
stdout '"upload": "none"'
cp $WORK/changed.txt $WORK/tampered/workdir.tar
! job resume -job $WORK/tampered
code 1
stderr 'frozen workdir snapshot changed'
accepted BeginArtifactUpload 1
calls SubmitWorkspaceJob 2

mutations 1

-- task.yaml --
workdir: .
resources:
  infra: aws/us-west-2
  cpus: 1
setup: |
  mkdir out && echo prepared >out/prepared.txt
run: |
  cat input.txt >out/result.txt
-- src/input.txt --
frozen
-- changed.txt --
changed
